Default assistant system prompt

default_system_prompt.Rd

The package-default persona used when new_assistant_extension() is called without a system_prompt argument. The text deliberately tells the model it cannot yet act on the board — Phase 1 ships no tools, and without an explicit instruction the model will happily hallucinate a CRUD vocabulary it does not have.

Usage

default_system_prompt()

Value

A character scalar.
